BlendPilot

Autonomous 3D Asset AI Synthesis & Multi-Agent Self-Correcting Geometry Engine for Blender

GitHub: https://github.com/Kowsik-Y/blendpilot

1. Executive Overview & Objectives

BlendPilot is an autonomous multi-agent AI copilot designed to translate natural language prompts into production-ready, clean 3D assets inside Blender. Built on LangGraph, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and live socket/HTTP bridges, BlendPilot orchestrates 11 specialized agents to perform intent understanding, scene parsing, topology research, step-by-step planning, autonomous modeling, PBR shading, deterministic geometry QA, vision-based aesthetic criticism, human review, and multi-format production export.

Why BlendPilot? (Problem Statement & Motivation)

The creation of 3D assets for games, film, and spatial computing remains a major industry bottleneck. Traditional 3D asset generation presents three critical challenges:

  • Manual Modeling Overhead: Crafting production-grade 3D assets requires specialized expertise across box modeling, modifier stacks, UV unwrapping, material node graphs, studio lighting, and topology retopology.
  • Failure of Single-Shot LLM Code Generation: Prompting standard LLMs to directly generate raw Blender Python (bpy) scripts yields a >70% failure rate due to non-manifold meshes, unapplied transformations, flipped face normals, syntax breaking across Blender versions, and untextured outputs.
  • Unusable Generative 3D Mesh AI (NeRFs / Point Clouds): Existing image-to-3D AI generators produce dense, noisy, non-editable triangle clouds with baked-in visual lighting that cannot be modified, animated, or integrated cleanly into real-time game engines.
BlendPilot bridges high-level artificial intelligence reasoning with Blender's professional CAD geometric kernel. Instead of raw code generation or uneditable point clouds, BlendPilot generates clean, parametric, structured 3D geometry with deterministic topological validation and automated self-repair loops.

Core System Objectives

  • 100% End-to-End Asset Synthesis: Transform complex text requests (e.g. "Create a low-poly sci-fi supply crate for Unity with glowing emissive strips") into production .blend, .fbx, and .glb files without manual intervention.
  • Deterministic Geometric Quality Assurance: Enforce zero non-manifold edges, accurate bounding box scaling, consistent face normals, and strict polygon budgets mathematically before export.
  • Autonomous Self-Correction & Repair: Automatically detect topological errors or visual flaws and route execution back to repair stages (up to 3x repair cycles) without crashing the application.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) Safety Boundary: Isolate LLM reasoning behind validated JSON tool calls (add_primitive, apply_modifier, edit_mesh, assign_material) to prevent invalid script execution.
  • Game Engine & Target Platform Compliance: Adapt mesh density, material node trees, and coordinate systems specifically for Unity, Unreal Engine 5, WebGL, or mobile targets.
  • Real-Time Telemetry & Human-in-the-Loop Review: Stream live agent thinking, intermediate renders, and topology metrics to a Next.js Three.js web interface via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

3. System Architecture & Pipeline Flow

The generation process flows through an ordered chain of specialized LLM agents with automated feedback and repair loops:

1. Intent → 2. Scene → 3. Research → 4. Planning → 5. Modeling → 6. Materials → 7. Math QA (Loop < 3x) → 8. Visual Critic (Loop < 3x) → 9. Review → 10. Export

State Routing & Repair Loops (`graph/routes.py`)

  • Geometry QA Self-Repair Route: If ValidationResult.status == "FAIL" and repair count < 3, the graph branches back to ModelingAgent with specific topological fix directives attached to state. If repair count >= 3, it routes to emergency decimation fallback.
  • Visual Critic Revision Route: If VisualCritiqueResult.quality_score < 0.80 and revision count < 3, state branches back to ModelingAgent or MaterialAgent depending on whether the issue is geometric or material-based.
  • Human Review Route: If human reviewer submits REQUEST_CHANGE, state returns to PlanningAgent. If APPROVE, it proceeds to ExportAgent.

4. Technology Stack, AI Models & RAG Architecture

BlendPilot combines multi-agent orchestration, multi-modal Vision LLMs, Model Context Protocol tools, vector RAG retrieval, and real-time 3D web graphics into an integrated architecture.

Core Technology Stack

Component Layer Technologies & Frameworks Used Key Capabilities & Functionality
Agent Engine & Graph Python 3.11+, LangGraph (v0.0.30+), LangChain (v0.2+), OpenTelemetry Stateful Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG), conditional route branching, and self-repair loops.
3D CAD & Geometry Engine Blender 4.0 / 5.2.0 LTS Native bpy, BMesh API, Cycles & Eevee Parametric modeling, modifier stack application, procedural PBR shading, Cycles rendering.
Model Context Protocol Custom Blender MCP Server (mcp_servers/blender/), JSON Schema Tool Bounds Predefined execution boundaries (add_primitive, apply_modifier, edit_mesh) isolating LLMs from raw code execution.
Backend REST & SSE API FastAPI (v0.100+), Uvicorn, AsyncIO, HTTPX, Server-Sent Events (SSE) Asynchronous job creation, real-time agent telemetry streaming, and human feedback endpoints.
Persistence & State Storage PostgreSQL, langgraph-checkpoint-postgres, Prisma ORM Checkpointing agent state graph across execution turns, self-repair iterations, and session resumes.
Frontend Web Studio Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, Lucide Icons Interactive Three.js 3D viewport canvas, node visualizer, chat interface, and settings panel.

AI Models & Multi-Modal Vision Integration

  • Primary Reasoning & Generation LLMs: OpenAI GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini, Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet / Claude 3 Opus, or OpenRouter API models for intent extraction, topology research, and step-by-step modeling plans.
  • Multi-Modal Vision Critic (Visual Critic Agent): Employs Vision-Language Models (GPT-4o Vision / Claude 3.5 Sonnet Vision) to visually evaluate rendered PNG previews of generated 3D assets against the original prompt, rating aesthetic quality and spec compliance on a 0.0–1.0 scale.
  • Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) & Local LLM Support: Configurable custom base URLs enabling local inference via Ollama (http://localhost:11434/v1), OpenRouter, or self-hosted OpenAI-compatible inference servers.

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) & Context Memory System

  • Engine Topology Guidelines RAG: The ResearchAgent utilizes vector retrieval over platform-specific topology knowledge bases (Unity triangle limits, Unreal Engine 5 Nanite geometry rules, WebGL polycount budgets, PBR texture packing standards) to instruct modeling steps before geometry creation.
  • Long-Horizon Session Checkpointing: Uses PostgreSQL checkpoint persistence (langgraph-checkpoint-postgres) to preserve conversation context, user review feedback, and scene state across long-running multi-agent sessions.
  • Context Window Pruning (128k Token Management): Implements structured state pruning and Pydantic schema validation (DesignSpec, DesignPlan, ValidationResult) to maintain high efficiency and prevent token window exhaustion during recursive self-repair loops.

5. The 11 Specialized Agents

Every agent in the pipeline has a dedicated role, system prompt, and Pydantic schema contract:

# Agent Name Source File Primary Function Output Schema
0 EnhancerAgent agents/enhancer_agent.py Pre-processes ambiguous prompts, adding physical context and material clarity. Enhanced String
1 IntentAgent agents/intent_agent.py Parses prompt into target dimensions, game engine, and polygon limit. DesignSpec
2 SceneAgent agents/scene_agent.py Scans active Blender scene to inspect existing geometry and object placement. SceneSummary
3 ResearchAgent agents/research_agent.py Retrieves target platform topology standards (Unity, Unreal, WebGL). ResearchFindings
4 PlanningAgent agents/planning_agent.py Generates an ordered, atomic step-by-step modeling breakdown. DesignPlan
5 ModelingAgent agents/modeling_agent.py Translates plan steps into MCP tool calls (primitives, modifiers, edit_mesh). ModelingResult
6 MaterialAgent agents/material_agent.py Creates Principled BSDF PBR shaders and 3-point studio lighting setups. MaterialResult
7 GeometryQAAgent agents/geometry_qa_agent.py Deterministic mathematical QA (non-manifold edges, flipped normals, polycount). ValidationResult
8 VisualCriticAgent agents/visual_critic_agent.py Multi-modal Vision LLM critique evaluating renders against original prompt. VisualCritiqueResult
9 FeedbackAgent agents/feedback_agent.py Human-in-the-loop review gate allowing APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGE. FeedbackResult
10 ExportAgent agents/export_agent.py Packages production .blend, .fbx, .glb, preview image, and JSON metadata. ExportResult

5. Multi-Service Launcher Orchestration (`run.sh` & `run.ps1`)

BlendPilot includes automated all-in-one launcher scripts for both Unix-like platforms (macOS/Linux) and Windows PowerShell that orchestrate and health-check all services concurrently.

Orchestrated Services Matrix

Service Name Target Port / Endpoint Function Health Check URL
Blender HTTP Bridge http://127.0.0.1:9876 Binds Python agents to native Blender `bpy` operators. /health
FastAPI Backend API http://localhost:8000 REST endpoints, job dispatch, and SSE telemetry streaming. /api/health
Next.js Web Frontend http://localhost:3000 Glassmorphic UI, Three.js 3D viewport, node visualizer. /
MkDocs Documentation http://localhost:8001 Live developer documentation site server. /

Bash Launcher (`run.sh`) Features

  • Automated Virtual Environment: Checks for .venv, initializes it via python3 -m venv, and runs pip install -e . if missing.
  • Port Ownership & Health Probing: Uses curl health checks and attaches to existing healthy service processes automatically.
  • Graceful Process Group Cleanup: Registers process group IDs (pgid) and captures SIGINT, SIGTERM, and EXIT signals to prevent orphan background processes on exit.
  • Automated Browser Launch: Uses open (macOS) or xdg-open (Linux) to automatically open http://localhost:3000.

PowerShell Launcher (`run.ps1`) Features

  • Windows Native PowerShell Jobs: Spawns background tasks via Start-Job and tracks job handles in $Jobs array.
  • TCP Connection Cleanup: Probes listening ports (3000, 8000, 8001, 9876) using Get-NetTCPConnection and terminates detached processes via Stop-Process.
  • Robust Error Trap: Uses a try {} finally {} block to guarantee cleanup when interrupted with Ctrl+C.

6. Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools

The Blender MCP server implementation (mcp_servers/blender/server.py) exposes 7 tool domain modules containing predefined, type-checked execution handlers:

  • Modeling Tools: add_primitive, apply_modifier, edit_mesh
  • Material & Lighting Tools: assign_material, create_principled_material, setup_lighting, render_preview
  • Object & Scene Tools: transform_object, duplicate_object, delete_object, get_scene_info, clear_scene
  • Validation & Project Tools: validate_geometry, check_topology, export_asset, save_blend_file

8. FastAPI Backend & Streaming Specifications

REST API Endpoints

# Submit Generation Request
POST /api/v1/generate
Header: Content-Type: application/json
Body: {
  "prompt": "Sci-fi supply crate for Unity",
  "target_engine": "unity",
  "polygon_budget": 8000
}
Response: { "job_id": "job_8f29a1" }

# Poll Graph Execution Status
GET /api/v1/status/{job_id}

# Submit Human Review Feedback
POST /api/v1/feedback/{job_id}
Body: { "status": "APPROVE", "comment": "Mesh clean" }

Server-Sent Events (SSE) Stream

# Real-Time Agent Telemetry Stream
GET /api/v1/stream/{job_id}

Stream Event Format:
event: agent_update
data: {
  "job_id": "job_8f29a1",
  "agent": "GeometryQAAgent",
  "status": "EXECUTING",
  "validation_result": { "status": "PASS", "score": 1.0, "triangle_count": 4200 },
  "intermediate_render": "/output/renders/job_8f29a1_preview.png"
}

9. Quickstart & Operating Commands

# 1. Environment Setup
git clone https://github.com/Kowsik-Y/blendpilot.git
cd blendpilot
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 2. Launch All Services via Shell Launcher (macOS / Linux)
bash run.sh

# 3. Launch All Services via Windows PowerShell (Windows)
.\run.ps1

# 4. Alternatively Launch FastAPI Backend Server Alone
.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload

# 5. Execute Single CLI Prompt
.venv/bin/python cli.py "Create a wooden stool. Dimensions: 0.35m x 0.35m x 0.45m."

# 6. Run Benchmark & Unit Tests
.venv/bin/python cli.py --benchmark
.venv/bin/pytest -v
